svg.title: Depthly Sessions — list and CSV export redesign
svg.desc: Two design states: a searchable, filterable, grouped session table with a scrollable body and persistent pagination, followed by a separate CSV export drawer with explicit date, project and break options. Example session values only.
svg.text: SESSION HISTORY · filters and pagination stay visible while the list scrolls
Find past focus sessions and breaks. Open a session to review its details.
Desktop proposal · session rows are grouped by date · row details and action menus remain separate targets
CSV EXPORT · a dedicated drawer keeps export choices separate from list filters
Find past focus sessions and breaks. Open a session to review its details.
Download your session history as a CSV file.
These choices apply to the download only.
Focus sessions · all dates · all projects
A CSV file you can open in a spreadsheet
CSV export is included with Pro and Lifetime.
Choose your range, then download the file.
Design preview only · illustrative session data · export settings do not imply that every list filter is supported by export
